intent: Extract phone_focus_mode together with python_pkg/focus_policy into one public repo, and fix the test suite's hidden dependency on an untracked secrets file rather than carrying it across.
scope: 2 Python suites from linux_configuration/tests/ and 6 mutation fixtures from meta/scripts/fixtures/mutations/ moved with them
check_python_location.sh: the phone_focus_mode exception removed now that the directory is gone
Non-goal: hosts and digital_wellbeing, deferred at the user's request
changes: Extracted both trees in one filter-repo pass (77 commits), hoisting phone_focus_mode to the root, python_pkg/focus_policy to focus_policy/, and rewriting python_pkg.focus_policy imports plus the mutation fixtures' phone_focus_mode/ path prefix.
Gave the new repo a conftest putting the root and lib/ on sys.path, a pyproject, a .shellcheckrc and CI covering Python, shellcheck and the shell suites.
Added a .gitignore to the new repo: none came across in the filter-repo pass and the repo is public. config_secrets.sh is ignored.
ctl_libs_harness.sh now pins HOME_LAT/HOME_LON to a pair 4300 m south of the coordinate its case seeds, instead of inheriting whatever config_secrets.sh holds.
config.sh sources config_secrets.sh only when it exists, so a clean clone and CI can run.
Tightened check_python_location.sh and the AGENTS.md rule it documents, dropping the exception for a directory that no longer exists.

verification.command: bash lib/tests/test_*.sh with NO config_secrets.sh present
verification.evidence: 10 of 11 suites pass, including test_ctl_libs.sh at 136/136. Before the fix it failed 'status distance should be ~4300 m, got 25555' with a placeholder secrets file and could not run at all without one.

verification.command: bash lib/tests/test_magisk_service.sh, in the extracted repo AND the pre-extraction baseline worktree
verification.evidence: Times out (exit 124) in the monorepo baseline too, and is named in no CI list there. Carried across knowingly; the new CI skips it explicitly with that reason rather than hiding it.

verification.command: git log --all -p | grep for the known home coordinates; git log for config_secrets.sh
verification.evidence: Zero matches across all history and the file was never committed, checked before the repo was made public. Remaining coordinate literals are the Warsaw city-centre test fixture (52.2297, 21.0122).

verification.command: pytest linux_configuration/tests; check_shell_coverage.sh --all; check_python_location.sh over every tracked .py
verification.evidence: 178 passed; coverage gate exit 0; all Python files pass the tightened location hook. Depth 262 -> 248.

risks: test_magisk_service.sh remains broken. It is skipped in CI with a stated reason, not silently dropped, but it is a real gap the new repo inherits.

python-tests.yml still filters on python_pkg/lichess_bot and tests/, neither of which has existed since the May 2026 archive commit. Pre-existing and harmless (a filter on a missing path just never matches); left alone rather than widening this change.
The distance assertion now encodes a synthetic home 4300 m from the fixture. If the seeded fix ever changes, the pinned pair must change with it - the harness comment says so.
rollback: git revert to restore both trees, the two tests and the mutation fixtures, then re-add the conftest entries, pylint sys.path elements, pre-commit exclude and the location-hook exception.
